name: CodeQL Bundle v2.27.4
body:
Bundles CodeQL CLI v2.27.4
- ([changelog](https://github.com/github/codeql-cli-binaries/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md), [release](https://github.com/github/codeql-cli-binaries/releases/tag/v2.27.4))

The combined `codeql-bundle.tar.gz` covers Linux x64, Windows x64 and macOS (including Apple Silicon). Linux arm64 is available as the per-platform `codeql-bundle-linux-arm64.tar.gz` only.

Includes the following CodeQL language packs from [`github/codeql@codeql-cli/v2.27.4`](https://github.com/github/codeql/tree/codeql-cli/v2.27.4):
- `codeql/actions-queries` ([changelog](https://github.com/github/codeql/tree/codeql-cli/v2.27.4/actions/ql/src/CHANGELOG.md), [source](https://github.com/github/codeql/tree/codeql-cli/v2.27.4/actions/ql/src))
- `codeql/actions-all` ([changelog](https://github.com/github/codeql/tree/codeql-cli/v2.27.4/actions/ql/lib/CHANGELOG.md), [source](https://github.com/github/codeql/tree/codeql-cli/v2.27.4/actions/ql/lib))
